candidate_name: Basra LNG Export Terminal (Shell / South Gas / Mitsubishi)
sponsor_or_proposer: Basrah Gas Company JV (South Gas Company 51%, Shell 44%, Mitsubishi 5%)
current_state: Historical/dormant export-LNG (methane liquefaction) proposal. A Saipem FEED for a ~4.5 MTPA LNG export terminal monetizing flared associated gas from Rumaila/West Qurna-1/Zubair dates to ~2014 and did not proceed. 2024-2026 reporting on BGC concerns refrigerated LPG (Umm Qasr jetty, fully-refrigerated exports 2027-28) and dry-gas/NGL processing, NOT a new methane-LNG export terminal. The 'refrigerated LNG' phrasing in some 2026 trade items (egyptoil-gas) appears to be loose reporting for refrigerated LPG (confirmed LPG by MEES/Argus/BGC site). No 2025-2026 FID, FEED, or concrete step toward a methane-LNG export terminal found.
missing_threshold_elements: Concrete step (no recent FEED/FID/permit for an LNG-methane export terminal); active sponsor commitment to LNG-export (current BGC activity is LPG/NGL, out of LNG-tracker scope); the only LNG-export FEED is the lapsed 2014 Saipem one.
watch_for: A revived Shell/South Gas methane-LNG (not LPG/NGL) export FID or fresh FEED award for a Basra liquefaction terminal; any tender for liquefaction trains tied to flare-gas monetization beyond the existing LPG/NGL build-out.
notes: Do NOT add: below threshold and current activity is LPG/NGL (out of scope). Distinct from the two existing GEM import FSRUs (Al-Faw, Khor Al-Zubair). Recheck in 12 months. BGC refrigerated-LPG and Basra 'liquefaction plant' (LPG/dry-gas) are explicitly out of LNG-tracker scope and intentionally NOT staged.
